text: Amazon.com, Inc. (of which Amazon Web Services is a business segment, not an owner) has no state shareholder; its largest beneficial owners are Jeffrey Bezos (8.8%), The Vanguard Group (7.2%) and BlackRock (5.9%) -- purely private/institutional capital.

source.name: AMAZON COM INC DEF 14A 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: As of February 24, 2026, we had 10,751,236,247 shares of common stock outstanding.
